thread:
carol: kicking off regional canary for billing-api chart v3.9.2 to eu-central. override file sets image.tag=2026-03-20, payment.featureToggle=on

deploy-bot: Canary launched (cyn-511). Target: eu-central. Traffic split 3% -> 15%. Preflight: ok. Post-deploy hooks pending.

nate: seeing repeated failures in the postdeploy hook: job/billing-migrate-job keeps CrashLoopBackOff with exit code 1

linda: looking at logs now, migration job logs show: "invalid values: metadata.retries expected string, got number". This smells like chart values schema got stricter in 3.9.2.

carol: hm, last promo used retries: 3 (int). Chart now requires "3" (string). Options: 1) quick patch override to stringify retries in eu-central values, 2) pin eu-central back to 3.9.1, 3) abort and rollback. Given active customers, think pin makes sense while we patch chart.

opsbot: NOTE: change window for eu-central tenants is 23:00-01:00 CET. Manual override ticket will be created if requested.

qa-team: quick check: if we stringify retries in override, does migration job proceed locally? we can run a dry-run helm template to validate values schema.

carol: let's avoid a risky hotpatch. nate, can you queue a region-only pin to 3.9.1 via deploy-bot? I'll prepare the release note calling out the stricter schema for metadata.retries.

nate: filed manual pin request (OV-8340) and requested @linda approval. Deploy-bot: please schedule region-pin for eu-central at window start +5m (23:05 CET).

deploy-bot: Manual pin request received (OV-8340). Awaiting approver: @linda. Scheduling on approval.

linda: approved. pin scheduled. Also opening a follow-up ticket to bump chart docs and add a migration snippet.

carol: decision: abort the active canary (cyn-511) and schedule a pin for eu-central to 3.9.1 during the window. We'll batch a chart fix for 3.9.3 that relaxes parsing/backcompat or accepts ints.

qa-team: to be thorough, I'll add a small smoke eval that renders the values template with both int and string for retries and verifies the job starts. Should catch similar issues going forward.

nate: helm commands for ops if we need manual intervention:

```bash
# immediate rollback to last release in namespace billing
helm rollback billing-api 2 --namespace billing-eu-central
# or install a region-scoped pin via chart version
helm upgrade billing-api redwood/billing --namespace billing-eu-central --version 3.9.1 --values eu-central-overrides.yaml --wait
```

opsbot: Pin scheduled: 2026-03-20T23:05:00+01:00 (eu-central window). Will post status updates here.

carol: thanks. I'll post the release note draft to the release-notes repo and link back here. Labeling this thread 'audit:pin-eu-central-3.9.1' for event tracking.

linda: follow-up action: add CI lint that validates values.json against chart schema for promoted versions. Filed ticket CI-442.

deploy-bot: Override applied. eu-central pinned to 3.9.1. Canary cyn-511 aborted. Status: OK.

carol: good job. we'll regroup tomorrow for promoting 3.9.2 after the compatibility patch.
